All three functions have been implemented and exported:

1. **`clamp(n, min, max)`** in `src/num.js` — returns n bounded to the inclusive range [min, max]
2. **`formatBytes(n)`** in `src/util.js` — formats byte counts as human-readable strings (B, KB, MB, GB) with one decimal place
3. **`slugify(title)`** in `src/text.js` — converts titles to URL-friendly slugs by lowercasing, trimming, replacing spaces with dashes, and removing special characters
